description: This course is preliminary and additional knowledge of physical and phenomenological occurrences in the physical and cosmological world. The student will learn how to determine the relevant physics concepts to be applied for any problems. The students will learn to use mathematical tools for every physical problem.
references: Young, H. D., & Freedman, R. A. University Physics with Modern Physics, 15th ed.
Halliday, D., Resnick, R., & Walker, J. Fundamentals of Physics, 11th ed.
videoCredit: Lecture videos in the modules: MIT OpenCourseWare, 8.01 Classical Mechanics, Fall 2016 (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), and Khan Academy (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 US). Each video is cited on its module page.
